archive.title: Archive record?
archive.description: The record will stop appearing in lists. You can restore it later.

void.title: Void record?
void.description: The record will be voided. This action cannot be undone from this screen.

cancel.title: Cancel record?
cancel.description: The record will be cancelled and will no longer be active.

delete.title: Delete record?
delete.description: The record will be deleted and you cannot recover it from this screen.

unlink.title: Unlink record?
unlink.description: The record will stop appearing on this link. It stays available in its list and on its other links.

archived.title: Archived record
archived.description: It is hidden from lists and searches.

unsavedChanges.message: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?
